name: Chūkabōchō no Himichi
flavorText: Chūkabōchō no Himicchi (中華包丁 の 火道) is a weapon used by the Carnibore, a well-known serial killer. The cleaver of the path of fire, imbued with the power of the underworld's fire. Each strike left a burning path to the target, and the sound of souls screaming out from the flame, as if one were in the underworld oneself. The blade is made of normal metal, but the durability is unmatched; no one knows how or when a normal cleaver becomes this virulent.
attunementRules: To use the ability slots, you must attune to the weapon. In order to attune to this weapon, you must score a critical hit with it and execute the target.

weaponStats.weaponStat: You can chose STR or HP to use with this weapon.

abilities.title: Path of Fire
abilities.description: twice per long rest, the cleaver creates a straight path erupting with underworld flame that deals 1d8 damage if one touches it.

abilities.title: Underworld Blessing
abilities.description: once per short rest, the bell will ring a clinking sound, like a toast celebrating the beginning of the party, every 30 seconds for 3 minutes, which gives a bonus action and +5 attack damage.

abilities.title: Burning Wound
abilities.description: after each attack, the target must make a Constitution check against your spell save DC. On a fail, the target will receive 1 fire damage each round until the target ends the Constitution check on a success.

name: The Crimson Wand
flavorText: 10.5 Inches long, made of Mahogany wood, and said to have a phoenix feather core. Wielding the wand grants the user the familiar warmth in summer.
attunementRules: To use the ability slots, you must attune to the weapon. In order to attune to this weapon, you must score a critical hit with it.

weaponStats.weaponStat: You can choose INT/WIS/CHA to use with this weapon.

level1Abilities.title: Empowered Fire
level1Abilities.description: While holding this wand, you can use an action to deplete 1 gp of charge to empower any fire properties spell to +1 fire damage.

level2Abilities.title: Aura of Phoenix
level2Abilities.description: At night, the wand will illuminate the warm light around 60 ft, slowly heal the debuff the people in the area have.

level2Abilities.title: Knowledge of the Phoenix
level2Abilities.description: The user can cast the following spells, combined a day thrice: detect evil and good, detect magic, dispel magic, shield, and flame strike.

level3Abilities.title: Remedial Flame
level3Abilities.description: Once per short rest, the wielder can cast Remedial Flame to instantly cure or heal the wound.

level3Abilities.title: Rejuvenation
level3Abilities.description: If the wielder dies, once per long rest, the phoenix feather will immediately bring the wielder back to life with 5 HP. Only a wish can prevent this trait from functioning.

name: Protection Talisman I

specs.properties: Grants minor resistance to a normal damage type

flavorText: A talisman drawed with a rune that grants protection to the user. The talisman is commonly used by everyone to protect themselves from minor accidents.

abilities.title: Consume
abilities.description: You regain 1d4 hit points and ignore the damage that less than 1d4 when you use this talisman as an action.

name: Protection Talisman II

specs.properties: Grants minor resistance to a normal damage type

flavorText: A talisman drawed with a rune that grants protection to the user. The talisman is commonly used by adventurers to protect themselves from common encounters.

abilities.title: Consume
abilities.description: You regain 1d4+2 hit points and ignore the damage that less than 1d4 when you use this talisman as an action.

name: Protection Talisman III

specs.properties: Grants minor resistance to a normal damage type

flavorText: A talisman drawed with a rune that grants protection to the user. The talisman is rarely used by adventurers to protect themselves from unusual dangers.

abilities.title: Consume
abilities.description: You regain 2d4 hit points and ignore the damage that less than 1d4 when you use this talisman as an action.

name: Protection Talisman V

specs.properties: Grants minor resistance to a normal damage type

flavorText: A talisman drawed with runes that grants protection to the user. The talisman is mostly used by the nobles to protect themselves from the lethal dangers.

abilities.title: Consume
abilities.description: You regain 2d4+1 hit points and ignore the damage that less than 1d8+1 when you use this talisman as an action.

name: Kunai
flavorText: A traditional multipurpose weapon crafted with fine steel imported from the north. A renowned weapon used by the people in the East.

abilities.title: Slash
abilities.description: 1d4 slashing damage to a target within 20 ft.

abilities.title: Thrown
abilities.description: 1d4 piercing damage to a target within 60 ft.

name: Aquamarine Kunai
flavorText: A traditional multipurpose weapon crafted with aquamarine imported from the south. A renowned weapon used by the people in the East.

abilities.title: Tidal Edge
abilities.description: Deals 1d4 slashing + 1 cold damage within 20 ft. Rinses wounds with oceanic chill, extinguishing nonmagical flames on the target.

abilities.title: Glacial Shard
abilities.description: Deals 1d4 piercing + 1 cold damage thrown up to 60 ft. On hit, freezing condensation reduces the target's movement speed by 10 ft until the end of their next turn.

name: Obsidian Kunai
flavorText: A traditional multipurpose weapon crafted with obsidian imported from the west. A renowned weapon used by the people in the East.

abilities.title: Glass Razor
abilities.description: Deals 1d4 slashing + 1d4 fire damage within 20 ft. Crafted from microscopic volcanic razor edges, scoring a critical hit on a roll of 19 or 20.

abilities.title: Volcanic Fracture
abilities.description: Deals 1d4 piercing + 1d4 fire damage thrown up to 60 ft. On hit, volcanic glass shards lodge in the wound, dealing 1 fire damage at the start of the target's next turn.

name: Malachite Kunai
flavorText: A traditional multipurpose weapon crafted with malachite imported from the north. A renowned weapon used by the people in the East.

abilities.title: Copper Verdigris
abilities.description: Deals 1d4 slashing + 1d4 poison damage within 20 ft. The toxic copper mineral seeps into cuts, forcing the target to succeed on a DC 12 Constitution saving throw or become poisoned for 1 round.

abilities.title: Caustic Dart
abilities.description: Deals 1d4 piercing + 1d4 acid damage thrown up to 60 ft as the copper carbonate reacts upon impact.

name: Ferruginous Kunai
flavorText: A traditional multipurpose weapon crafted with ferruginous quartz imported from the south. A renowned weapon used by the people in the East.

abilities.title: Hematite Magnetism
abilities.description: Deals 1d6 slashing + 1 lightning damage within 20 ft. The iron-rich mineral gains advantage on attack rolls against targets wearing metal armor.

abilities.title: Piezo Resonance
abilities.description: Deals 1d6 piercing + 1 lightning damage thrown up to 60 ft, discharging the quartz's stored kinetic shockwave upon impact.

name: Bloodletter Pen
flavorText: This elegant fountain pen is coated in crimson lacquer and finished with gold accents. Its glass chamber holds wine-red ink with a beautiful, mysterious scent. Words written with the pen do not fade through ordinary wear or age.

abilities.title: Ignition Blood
abilities.description: Once per Short or Long Rest, you can take a Magic action to speak a word currently written by the pen on a surface you can see within 60 feet. The writing erupts. Each creature within 5 feet of it must make a DC 12 Dexterity saving throw, taking 1d6 Fire damage on a failed save or half as much damage on a successful one. The triggered writing then disappears.

name: Gambler’s Coin
flavorText: This gold coin sits comfortably in the palm and is slightly larger than ordinary currency. One face depicts Fortuna, goddess of luck. The reverse bears the symbol of Beshaba, lady of doom.

abilities.title: Lady Luck
abilities.description: Twice per Long Rest, when you are about to make a D20 Test without Advantage or Disadvantage, you can flip this coin instead of rolling. Treat heads as if the d20 rolled a 20 and tails as if it rolled a 1.

name: Gloves of Thievery
flavorText: These sheer gloves appear to be woven from invisible silk. Once worn, they become imperceptible.

abilities.title: Thievery
abilities.description: While wearing the gloves, you gain a +5 bonus to Dexterity (Sleight of Hand) checks.

name: Iron Hand
flavorText: This battered iron gauntlet looks salvaged from a junkyard. A protection rune marks its back, though nothing shows whether the rune still holds power. Its rigid joints allow almost no movement at the wrist.

abilities.title: Last Resort
abilities.description: When an attack hits you during the first round of combat before you have taken a turn, you can use your Reaction and roll a d20. On a roll of 16 or higher, the gauntlet reduces the attack’s damage to 0.

name: Nanboku no Rensa
flavorText: This kusari-fundo bears opposing inscriptions: north on one end and south on the other. Tiny handmade magnets set along the chain amplify their attraction and repulsion.

abilities.title: Embrace
abilities.description: Once on each of your turns when you hit with this weapon, you can align matching poles against the target. Roll the weapon’s damage die twice for that attack.

abilities.title: Depart
abilities.description: As a Magic action, choose one creature you can see within 60 feet. The target must succeed on a DC 13 Strength saving throw or be pulled up to 20 feet toward you.

name: Invictus
flavorText: Invictus resembles an old wooden recurve bow. An ancient enchantment allows only a suitable bearer to string and fire it. At the end of every seventh day, the bow unstrings itself.

abilities.title: I’m Just a Man
abilities.description: To string Invictus, roll a d20 without adding a modifier; the attempt succeeds only on a 20. Once strung, an attack made with Invictus hits only if the attack roll is a natural 20. On that hit, the attack deals 3d20 Piercing damage instead of the longbow’s normal damage. Invictus uses Dexterity for its attack and damage rolls.

name: Jade Heart Spear
flavorText: This spear comes from an unknown source. Its heart-shaped jade head is lashed to a dry oak shaft with worn cord. Many stories claim to explain its origin and power, but none has proved true.

abilities.title: Undeath Nullify
abilities.description: An Undead creature killed by this spear can’t regain Hit Points or return to undeath unless a Wish spell restores it.

abilities.title: Sap Mastery
abilities.description: If you have a feature that lets you use this weapon’s mastery property, a creature you hit with the spear has Disadvantage on its next attack roll before the start of your next turn.

name: Wooden Axe
flavorText: A practical handaxe with a wooden haft and an ordinary iron head. Woodsfolk and adventurers carry it as both a tool and a weapon.

abilities.title: Vex Mastery
abilities.description: If you have a feature that lets you use this weapon’s mastery property, hitting a creature with the axe gives you Advantage on your next attack roll against that creature before the end of your next turn.

name: Potion of Invisibility
flavorText: This potion looks empty, but the container feels heavy and liquid sloshes inside it.

abilities.title: Invisibility
abilities.description: As a Bonus Action, you can drink the potion to gain the Invisible condition for 10 minutes. The effect ends early immediately after you make an attack roll, deal damage, or cast a spell.

name: Potion of Poison
flavorText: This liquid resembles a beneficial potion at first glance, but a bitter chemical scent clings to the stopper.

abilities.title: Toxic Draught
abilities.description: A creature that drinks the potion takes 1d4 Poison damage at the start of each of its turns for up to 30 minutes. At the end of each of those turns, it can make a DC 13 Constitution saving throw, ending the effect on a success.
